heading: SatSandesh voice demo
subheading: Speak a note in your language, read it in English, then send a reply and hear it spoken.
host_banner: The microphone only works when this page is opened as http://127.0.0.1:{port}/ — not through a LAN IP or computer name. Typing text still works.
status_ready: Ready. Press Start recording, speak one sentence, then press Stop.
status_recording: Recording — speak now, then press Stop.
status_recording_server: Recording on the console PC — speak now… {left}s left
status_done: Done. Press Start recording to try another note.
status_done_typed: Done. Type another sentence, or press Start recording.
hint_no_sound: No sound is reaching the microphone — check it is not muted.
type_placeholder: Type or paste a sentence in the language selected above…
advanced_summary: Advanced: record on the console PC's own microphone
advanced_note: Server-side recording; the browser microphone above is the normal path.
note_empty: Nothing yet. Record or type a note.
note_is_english: This note is already in English.
reply_hint: Write the reply in English. It is translated and spoken in the language chosen below.
reply_placeholder: English reply to translate and speak…
audio_unavailable: Audio is not available for this one — showing the text only.
english_voice_unavailable: No English voice is available on this PC, so this reply is shown as text only.
autoplay_blocked: Your browser blocked autoplay — press Play.
audio_failed: Could not play the audio. Press Play to try again.
details_voice_demo: Demo-only Windows voice, not the product voice.
err_console_down_title: The demo console is not responding
err_console_down_msg: The page could not reach its own backend. Is start_demo.py still running? Start it again if needed, then press Try again.
err_timeout_msg: No response in time. Check the service windows, then press Try again.
err_mic_blocked_msg: Allow microphone access in the browser address bar, then press Try again. You can still type text below.
err_no_mic_msg: No input device was found. Plug in or enable a microphone, then press Try again. You can still type text below.
err_mic_busy_msg: Another app may be using the microphone. Close it, then press Try again.
err_mic_start_msg: {detail} Press Try again, or type text below.
err_insecure_title: The browser blocks the microphone on this address
err_insecure_msg: Open this page as http://127.0.0.1:{port}/ (not a LAN IP or computer name) so the browser allows the microphone. You can still type text below.
err_too_short_msg: Speak for a second or two before pressing Stop, then press Try again.
err_upstream_down_msg: Run the start command again; it starts only what is missing. Then press Try again.
err_upstream_timeout_msg: The service may be overloaded. Wait a moment, then press Try again.
err_upstream_warming_msg: The model is still loading. Wait a few seconds, then press Try again.
err_asr_en_unavailable_title: English speech needs the faster-whisper service
err_asr_en_unavailable_msg: English recordings cannot be turned into text right now. You can still type English below, and Telugu and Hindi are not affected. Start the demo without “--asr-en off”, then press Try again.
err_silent_msg: The microphone picked up almost nothing. Check it is not muted and speak a little closer, then press Try again.
err_no_speech_msg: The recording was heard but no words were recognised. Speak clearly and press Try again.
